evidence: Discrete finite-difference residual and sampled Q values are reproducible.
No validated existence/error theorem transfers the sampled surface to an exact MOTS; grid-derived Lipschitz/quadrature estimates are not certified continuum bounds.
Therefore the stated exact eigenvalue enclosure and certification of strict stability are unsupported.
Pook-Kolb et al. 2019 already study the stability parameter in binary Brill-Lindquist data, so the broad first/no-prior-work claim must be removed.
Targeted searches did not locate the same equal-bare-mass 1,1 separation-2 numerical table; repaired claim is only a benchmark with no priority assertion.
Archived profiles and replay code provide a useful numerical benchmark for horizon/stability implementations.
